item.title: Grounding an ADK 2 Agent on BigQuery Semantic Graphs
item.description: Pairing a self-documenting BigQuery Property Graph in Knowledge Catalog with a compact portable skill and gemini-4-hydrogen (LOW thinking) on Google ADK 2 to reach 20/20 accuracy, groundedness, and SQL governance.

item.title: A Self-Documenting Semantic Layer in BigQuery Graph
item.description: Building a shared, grain-locked semantic layer inside BigQuery Graph over four ordinary relational tables using MEASURE(), GRAPH_EXPAND, AGG(), and ISO GQL MATCH.
